Spirit cannot be gained or lost while the Spirit Gauge is full, a Striker is active, or during Special Attacks.

applications.name: [625ce6]PROLIFERATE[-] - Special Knockdown
applications.description: The Defender gains 1 [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charge[/k] every 2 seconds. Max: 20. This timer is paused during Special Attacks, and for 1 seconds every time the Defender is knocked down by a Special Attack per level of the Special Attack.
applications.rawDescription: The Defender gains {1} [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charge[/k] every {0} seconds. Max: {3}. This timer is paused during Special Attacks, and for {2} seconds every time the Defender is knocked down by a Special Attack per level of the Special Attack.

applications.name: [b53442]ERADICATE[-] - Punish Special with Heavy
applications.description: Whenever the Defender's Special Attacks are [k=glossary/punishes]Punished[/k] by a Heavy Attack while they have 10 or more [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charges[/k], they are [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for 250% of the Attacker's Base Attack.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Defender's Special Attacks are [k=glossary/punishes]Punished[/k] by a Heavy Attack while they have {3} or more [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charges[/k], they are [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for {1}% of the Attacker's Base Attack.

applications.name: [d3832d]THRESHOLD[-] - Root

applications.rawDescription: The Defender gains {1} [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charge[/k] every {0} seconds. Max: {3}. This timer is paused during Special Attacks, and for {2} seconds every time the Defender is knocked down by a Special Attack per level of the Special Attack.

applications.name: [b53442]ERADICATE[-] - Punish Special with Heavy
applications.description: Whenever the Defender's Special Attacks are [k=glossary/punishes]Punished[/k] by a Heavy Attack while they have 10 or more [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charges[/k], they are [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for 250% of the Attacker's Base Attack.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Defender's Special Attacks are [k=glossary/punishes]Punished[/k] by a Heavy Attack while they have {3} or more [k=glossary/story_scourge]Scourge Charges[/k], they are [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for {1}% of the Attacker's Base Attack.

applications.name: [d3832d]THRESHOLD[-] - Root
applications.description: Whenever Scourge reaches a multiple of 5, the Attacker is Passively [k=glossary/root]Rooted[/k] for 3 seconds and Scourge gains are paused for 3 seconds.\nWhen this happens at 15 Scourge, if Scourge doesn't decrease by the end of the pause, the Attacker is [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for 20% of the Defender's Base Attack.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever Scourge reaches a multiple of {3}, the Attacker is Passively [k=glossary/root]Rooted[/k] for {2} seconds and Scourge gains are paused for {0} seconds.\nWhen this happens at 15 Scourge, if Scourge doesn't decrease by the end of the pause, the Attacker is [k=glossary/story_eradicate][b53442]Eradicated[-][/k] for {1}% of the Defender's Base Attack.

applications.name: Down and Out - 1
applications.description: Whenever the Attacker knocks the Defender down with a Heavy Attack, they have 10 seconds to use a Special Attack or they take 50% of their max Health as a burst of Direct Damage.
applications.rawDescription: Whenever the Attacker knocks the Defender down with a Heavy Attack, they have {2} seconds to use a Special Attack or they take 50% of their max Health as a burst of Direct Damage.
